newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ST PAULI-BOCHUM POSTPONED BECAUSE OF WATERLOGGED PITCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ST PAULI-BOCHUM POSTPONED BECAUSE OF WATERLOGGED PITCH.

text.p: St Pauli were forced to call off their German first division match against Bochum on Saturday because of a waterlogged pitch.

The game, the first Bundesliga encounter to fall victim to the weather this season, had already been moved from Friday. St Pauli officials said it was now not likely to be played until after the winter break in February.
